title: picris scabra subsp. abyssinica
intro: Picris scabra subsp. abyssinica, commonly known as Abyssinian picris, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe various health issues such as skin conditions and infections. The therapeutic actions of Abyssinian picris include reducing inflammation, fighting off bacterial and fungal infections, and exhibiting antioxidant activity, which helps to protect cells from damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
